description: Read public Instagram data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional count): profiles that match, one page with no cursor. media (id): one post by shortcode, numeric ID, or URL. profile (username): one profile. profile_posts (username; optional count, cursor): a user's posts. comments (shortcode; optional count, cursor): a post's comments. hashtag (tag; optional count, cursor): posts with a hashtag. media and profile return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }. For the next page, call again with the same action and target and cursor set to next_cursor, unchanged; next_cursor is null on the last page. A cursor lasts 24 hours.

count.description: Most items to return (1-100). API default: 10 for search, 20 for the other list actions. One page may hold fewer.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same action and target, sent back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

id.description: media: the post shortcode, numeric media ID, or public URL.

shortcode.description: comments: the code in the post URL, such as 'DeuOR-CjKE9' in https://www.instagram.com/p/DeuOR-CjKE9/. Numeric media IDs return 404.

tag.description: hashtag: the hashtag without #, example: 'ai'. A leading # is removed.

username.description: profile, profile_posts: Instagram username, example: 'instagram'. A leading @ is removed.

name: instagram
title: Instagram
